1.author: Alex
1.comment: Tim Burton at his atmospheric peak. The foggy woods, jack-o'-lanterns, and gothic sets make this the ultimate October 1 kickoff.

2.author: Alex
2.comment: Peak 80s practical effects! Slimer and the Stay Puft Marshmallow Man are timeless comfort horror.

16.author: Alex
16.comment: Ash Williams with a chainsaw arm is pure Halloween joy. The laughing deer head scene is comedy horror perfection!
